actions.name: Netwalker encrypts all connected Windows-based devices and data
actions.description: Following a successful intrusion, Netwalker encrypts all connected Windows-based devices and data, rendering critical files, databases, and applications inaccessible to users.

actions.name: Netwalker deploys an embedded configuration including ransom note and configuration options
actions.description: When executed, Netwalker deploys an embedded configuration that includes a ransom note, ransom note file names, and various configuration options.

actions.name: Actors using Netwalker spread ransomware through COVID-19 phishing emails with VBS script attachment
actions.description: Netwalker spread through a Visual Basic Scripting (VBS) script attached to COVID-19 phishing e-mails that executed the payload once opened.

actions.name: Actors using Netwalker gain unauthorized access by exploiting unpatched VPN appliances, vulnerable web UI components, or weak RDP passwords
actions.description: Actors using Netwalker began gaining unauthorized access to victim networks by exploiting unpatched Virtual Private Network (VPN) appliances, vulnerable user interface components in web applications, or weak passwords used for Remote Desktop Protocol connections.

actions.name: Actors exploit Pulse Secure VPN (CVE-2019-11510) and Telerik UI (CVE-2019-18935) vulnerabilities
actions.description: Two of the most common vulnerabilities exploited by actors using Netwalker are Pulse Secure VPN (CVE-2019-11510) and Telerik UI (CVE-2019-18935).

actions.name: Actors execute malicious programs to harvest administrator credentials, steal data, and encrypt user files
actions.description: Once an actor has infiltrated a network with Netwalker, a combination of malicious programs may be executed to harvest administrator credentials, steal valuable data, and encrypt user files.

actions.name: Actors launch malicious PowerShell script embedded with Netwalker ransomware executable to encrypt user files
actions.description: In order to encrypt the user files on a victim network, the actors typically launch a malicious PowerShell script embedded with the Netwalker ransomware executable.

actions.name: Actors upload stolen data to MEGA cloud storage and file sharing service
actions.description: Actors using Netwalker have previously uploaded stolen data to the cloud storage and file sharing service, MEGA.NZ (MEGA), by uploading the data through the MEGA website or by installing the MEGA client application directly on a victim’s computer.

actions.name: Actors transitioned to uploading stolen data to website.dropmefiles.com
actions.description: In June 2020, actors transitioned from uploading and releasing stolen data on MEGA to uploading the stolen data to another file sharing service: website.dropmefiles.com.
